# Living Spaces Gardening
> Native landscaping, garden design, and habitat restoration serving residential and commercial clients in the Tampa Bay and St. Petersburg, Florida area using exclusively Florida native plants.
Living Spaces Gardening was founded in 2018 by Kiamesha Wray, an experienced Florida Master Naturalist and FANN credentialed native plant professional. The company designs and installs native plant landscapes that support local ecosystems while creating beautiful, low-maintenance outdoor spaces for homes and businesses across Tampa Bay.
## Main Pages
- [Homepage](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/): Overview of native landscaping services for homes and businesses in Tampa Bay
- [About](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/#about): Kiamesha Wray's background, credentials, and the Living Spaces Gardening story
- [Services](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/#services): Full list of native landscaping and garden design services
- [For HOAs and Communities](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/for-hoa): Native landscaping conversion services for HOA communities, condo associations, and neighborhood boards in Tampa Bay
- [HOA Guide](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/hoa-guide): Free downloadable guide for HOA boards on converting community landscapes to Florida native plants
- [Press](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/press.html): Media coverage and features including Homes and Gardens magazine
- [Contact](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/#contact): Get in touch or request a consultation
## Service Areas
- [St. Petersburg, FL](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/service-areas/st-petersburg-fl): Native landscaping in St. Petersburg including Old Northeast, Historic Kenwood, Crescent Lake, Snell Isle, Shore Acres, and Grand Central
- [Gulfport, FL](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/service-areas/gulfport-fl): Native landscaping in Gulfport including the Art District, Historic Waterfront, and Stetson area
- [Pinellas Park, FL](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/service-areas/pinellas-park-fl): Native landscaping in Pinellas Park including Mainlands, Skyview, and Meadowlawn
- [Largo, FL](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/service-areas/largo-fl): Native landscaping in Largo including Belleair Bluffs, East Bay, Indian Rocks, Walsingham, and High Point
- [Clearwater, FL](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/service-areas/clearwater-fl): Native landscaping in Clearwater including Clearwater Beach, Island Estates, Sand Key, Morningside, Countryside, and Harbor Oaks
- [Dunedin, FL](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/service-areas/dunedin-fl): Native landscaping in Dunedin including Historic Downtown, Curlew Corridor, Honeymoon Island area, and Dunedin Isles
- [Tarpon Springs, FL](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/service-areas/tarpon-springs-fl): Native landscaping in Tarpon Springs including the Sponge Docks area, Downtown, Whitcomb Bayou, and Tarpon Lake
- [Redington Beach, FL](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/service-areas/redington-beach-fl): Native landscaping across Redington Beach, North Redington Beach, and Redington Shores
- [Treasure Island, FL](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/service-areas/treasure-island-fl): Native landscaping in Treasure Island including Sunshine Beach, Sunset Beach, and Isle of Palms
- [Madeira Beach, FL](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/service-areas/madeira-beach-fl): Native landscaping in Madeira Beach including the John's Pass area and Gulf Blvd Corridor
- [Tampa, FL](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/service-areas/tampa-fl): Native landscaping throughout Tampa including Seminole Heights, Hyde Park, Ybor City, Carrollwood, Westchase, and New Tampa
- [South Tampa, FL](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/service-areas/south-tampa-fl): Native landscaping in South Tampa including Hyde Park, Palma Ceia, Davis Islands, Bayshore, Beach Park, and Sunset Park
- [Pinellas County, FL](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/service-areas/pinellas-county-fl): Native landscaping across all of Pinellas County, including Palm Harbor, Safety Harbor, Seminole, Belleair, and Oldsmar
